purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: writing lecture; vocabulary (一定/形式/内部/諸/一覧) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 報告書は、一定の形式で書きます。
lines.en: Reports are written in a fixed format.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 形式は、なぜ決まっているんですか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 一定の形式だと、読みやすいからです。
lines.en: A fixed format makes it easy to read.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 内部の構成も、決まっていますか?
lines.en: Is the internal structure fixed too?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 内部は、序論や結論に分かれます。
lines.en: Internally, it's divided into intro and conclusion.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 参考にした諸資料は、どう示しますか?
lines.en: How do we show the various references?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 諸資料を、一覧にして載せます。
lines.en: We list the various references in a table.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一覧があると、分かりやすいですね。
lines.en: A list makes it easy to understand.
lines.style: satisfied adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
